How is a gRPC gateway service going?
Buf for protobuf linting and generation is the direction we committed to. Should we add more coverage?

Next steps for a gRPC gateway service?

Once the release settles, reducing allocations in the serialiser is where attention goes. Vendoring the internal proto definitions keeps getting pushed to next sprint. A worker pool bounded at 32 goroutines is behind us now.

Most of yesterday disappeared into context deadline exceeded on the upstream call. internal/handler/orders_test.go grew by a couple hundred lines. Replacing the mutex with a sharded map keeps getting pushed to next sprint.
The bulk of the diff sits in internal/worker/pool.go. Once the release settles, a fuzz test on the decoder is where attention goes.
Thanks to structured logging with request correlation, the on-call pages stopped. The bulk of the diff sits in proto/orders.proto. Flaky jobs get one automatic retry.
The trade-offs all pointed to gRPC over REST for internal traffic. Go 1.23 as the toolchain is the direction we committed to.
